$description: House-style token source for the svg skill. DTCG-leaning ($type/$value) so a set shares one style source. Numbers are research-grounded defaults (Material/Apple/Microsoft icon grids, layered SVG filter recipes); tune per brief but keep them constant across every icon in a set. See references/house-style.md for how to apply these.
$schema_note: Not a frozen schema — the final token format is confirmed during implementation. Treat $value shapes as the contract the loop reads.

grid.$description: Keyline grid units (viewBox 0 0 24 24). Build every icon against the same keyline shapes (square/circle/rect) for optical consistency.

live_area.$description: Padded live area inside the 24 grid (2-unit margin all sides).

corner_radius.$description: Default corner radius. Use 0 only for intentionally sharp marks. Constant across the set.

stroke_width.$description: Default stroke width; drop to 1.5 for fine interior detail. Constant across the set.

alignment.$description: Optical centering, not mathematical — adjust by eye so the icon looks centered.

palette.$description: Procedural lanes from a base hue. Each lane is light/base/dark tones of one hue. Gradient pairs draw from adjacent steps on a SINGLE lane — never arbitrary multi-hue gradients.

base_hue.$description: Default base hue (HSL degrees). Overridden by the brief's base hue / semantic; falls back to this lane when the brief gives none.

semantics.$description: Named base hues a brief's base_hue can reference (e.g. base_hue: success). Each resolves to a hue that builds its own lane via the same construction (house-style.md §2). A name not listed here falls back to base_hue. Extend as needed.

gradient_angle_deg.$description: Default gradient angle. Subtle, consistent across the set.

gradient.$description: Two layers stacked for richness (SVG has no native mesh — approximate with layered linear + radial).

body.$description: Base body fill, top-light to bottom-dark.

highlight.$orientation: radial, focal point fx=0.32 fy=0.28 offset from center cx=0.5 cy=0.5
highlight.$description: Off-center glossy light core — the dimensional-pop trick. Layer over the body fill.

depth.$description: Layered compositing produces premium dimensionality. NOT feSpecularLighting alone.

bevel.$description: Dark edge + light edge on opposing sides reads as a beveled rim.

weight_dial.$description: The dial scales ONLY the depth-stack. Geometry, palette, and cohesion are constant across all weights. Default is dimensional.

flat.$note: No depth-stack. Solid or single-gradient fill on the grid, with the set's stroke/palette.

soft.$note: Body gradient + soft drop shadow. Bevel and radial highlight omitted (or highlight at <=0.25 opacity).
